title: Chat.activeCallId stale pointer — no remediation path
description: Chat spec line 530-531: server sets activeCallId when VTCCall enters active state, clears on end. No mechanism defined for recovery if the cross-subsystem write fails (e.g., VTC crashes mid-transition, separate DB shards). Client sees activeCallId pointing at ended call indefinitely. No /repair method, no TTL, no way to distinguish stale pointer from race.
